Thieves target shops in separate incidents

In separate incidents, thieves broke into two shops, stealing cash and goods. In Dinanagar, a grocery store was targeted, with thieves making off with cash and merchandise. In Gorakhpur, thieves broke into a shop by breaching a roof gate and a wall, stealing cash and jewelry. Both incidents involved the theft of valuables and goods from commercial establishments.
